name: AI-visibility consulting for local businesses
summary: Scan a business’s website for the signals AI assistants actually read, hand them the evidence and the fix list. Engine cost is about $0.65 per client; SEO consultancies bill monthly retainers for less concrete work.

endpoints.description: Live AI-visibility check (GEO/AEO) w/ verbatim site evidence

payment.pricing_note: Prices shown are the live public catalog — the same wholesale sheet agents pay per call. No subscription.
payment.human_onramp: Self-serve starter key (no crypto wallet needed): https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/start/?bp=ai-visibility-consultant — scoped key with a $0.25 trial balance; top up by card (Stripe) or USDC. API: POST https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/api/wholesale/register {contact, scope: "marketpulse"}. Email fallback: info@theaslangroupllc.com with subject "Starter key: ai-visibility-consultant".

setup_steps: Scan your own site first, fix what it flags, and keep the before-and-after. A consultant whose own site grades “strong” opens every conversation from the right side of the table.
Scan ten local businesses you’d want as clients. The ones blocking AI crawlers without knowing it are your warmest calls: you’re not selling, you’re showing them their own robots.txt.
Set a flat diagnostic fee and a separate implementation fee. The scan costs you fifty cents; established SEO consultancies bill monthly retainers for reporting less concrete than this.
Deliver the first three as paid pilots at half price in exchange for a re-scan testimonial once their grade moves.
Offer a quarterly re-scan subscription. Sites drift, platforms change crawler names, and the re-scan is recurring revenue with near-zero marginal work.
licensing_notes: Website consulting is unregulated nearly everywhere. The honest-practice rules are commercial, not legal: never promise a ranking or a recommendation rate (no one can), sell the evidence and the fixes, and let re-scans do the proving. If you also run ads for clients, disclose any affiliate or platform relationships plainly.

compliance.earnings: Educational content. No earnings claims or income projections; results depend on operator effort, market, and pricing.
compliance.posture: Flat-fee self-help document preparation where documents are involved: the customer signs and files; the operator never represents clients or works on contingency.
